QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] According to the Traitor
QuestInfo.0: The Black Viking claims he is a victim in this as well. The Prime Minister was right next to him, looking pretty beat up. Bring the Prime Minister back to the castle.
QuestInfo.1: The Prime Minister would like you to arrest him right away, probably because the Black Viking was beating up on him. Bring the Prime Minister back to the Mushking.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the Prime Minister back to Mushroom Castle. The Mushking seemed relieved that the root of all evil was caught.

0.0: P-please, get me out of here! I won't last much longer! Hurry, take me away from this place!
0.1: Let's go! Go, go go! Pleeeease!

no.0: W-why aren't you taking me? I thought you were here to capture me!

1.0: Did you finally get the Prime Minister? This is great! The threat of uprising to our Mushking Empire has come to an end!

npc.0: Where is the Prime Minister? We need to capture him to be safe.
